{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.33) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% when recent true outcomes show strong downward momentum (e.g., 3 consecutive drops > 10% from prior day).",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is > 15% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 10-20% unless sentiment is strongly bullish (>0.67).",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecasted 3-5 days prior, adjust future forecasts downward by 5-15% to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "Cap forecast spikes above 20% above recent peak — especially when sentiment is low or market shows signs of cooling (e.g., 3 consecutive days of price decline).",
    "When sentiment is bullish (≥0.67) and forecast is below recent 30-day average, increase forecast by 5-10% to align with sentiment-driven momentum.",
    "If model consistently overpredicts after a spike (e.g., 3+ consecutive days of high forecast vs. low true outcome), apply a 10-20% downward correction to subsequent forecasts."
  ]
}
